snippet.title: The Siege and the Sandfox | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
It’s time to reclaim your honour, Sandfox!

The Siege and the Sandfox is out now on Steam, Epic Games Store, GOG, and Humble: https://siegeandsandfox.com/

In this 2D stealthvania with parkour-platforming, don the mantle of the legendary Sandfox and save your kingdom under siege. 
 
Betrayed by your Queen, so that she may hide her regicide, you must now save the kingdom from her evil plot, reap revenge, and reclaim your honour.

Remain unseen and unheard to evade the capture of the nastier inhabitants of this underground world whilst providing aid to those friendlier to a new face.

Discover and acquire dynamic parkour skills to progress and unlock previously unreachable new areas.

Sneak, slink, and scale your way through a majestic palace and crumbling prisons. Unravel the truth buried beneath the kingdom—and rise from the depths to save it. 
 
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/653060/The_Siege_and_the_Sandfox/  
EGS ► https://store.epicgames.com/p/the-siege-and-the-sandfox  
GOG ► https://www.gog.com/en/game/the_siege_and_the_sandfox 
Humble ► https://www.humblebundle.com/store/the-siege-and-the-sandfox
